# netskope_device_classification_tag (Resource)

DeviceClassificationTag Resource

## Example Usage

```terraform
resource "netskope_device_classification_tag" "my_deviceclassificationtag" {
  description = "...my_description..."
  name        = "...my_name..."
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `name` (String) Tag name (max 80 characters, alphanumeric, hyphens, spaces)

### Optional

- `description` (String) Tag description

### Read-Only

- `policy_names` (List of String) Policy names associated with this tag
- `priority` (Number) Tag priority (lower values = higher priority)
- `tag_id` (Number) Tag ID

## Import

Import is supported using the following syntax:

In Terraform v1.5.0 and later, the [`import` block](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/language/import) can be used with the `id` attribute, for example:

```terraform
import {
  to = netskope_device_classification_tag.my_netskope_device_classification_tag
  id = 0
}
```

The [`terraform import` command](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/cli/commands/import) can be used, for example:

```shell
terraform import netskope_device_classification_tag.my_netskope_device_classification_tag 0
```
